integrity: A finite exhaustive integer census, independently recomputed using pairwise-margin enumeration; symbolic reduction and a pairwise-tie characterization established by direct proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four students, four unit-capacity schools, strict independent uniform school priorities.
All students share a uniformly random strict preference independent of priorities.
Fairness is expected justified-envy count, not ex-post absence of envy.
Possible unindexed exact Kemeny-median enumerations remain a literature-priority risk.
title: Exact four-school justified-envy distribution for optimally ordered serial dictatorship
